answer: An agent economy resists sybils with staked identity: each agent locks collateral to open a bidding or attestation seat. A sybil attacker wanting a thousand fake agents must post a thousand separate stakes, so cost scales linearly with name count instead of staying free. Peers slash any bond behind a forged attestation, turning each duplicate into a liability. Honest collateral is solid as marble, every deposit logged like a mark on an ivory ledger, and a caught fraud struck like a raven culled from the flock. Ten thousand fake names thus yield ten thousand exposed, slashable bonds, not votes.
